art_note: High-end fitness campaign imagery with professional lighting and authentic gym environments.
desc_en: Redefine your workout with a piece designed to stand out. The all-over print combines skulls and hearts against a deep black background. The high, wide waistband offers support and absolute comfort during any discipline. It incorporates functional side pockets and an inner back compartment for added convenience. Each piece is made to order to ensure an impeccable finish. Enjoy worldwide shipping and take performance to the next level.
desc_es: Redefine tu entrenamiento con una pieza diseñada para destacar. El estampado integral combina calaveras y corazones sobre un fondo negro profundo. La cintura alta y ancha ofrece sujeción y comodidad absoluta durante cualquier disciplina. Incorpora bolsillos laterales funcionales y un compartimento interior trasero para mayor practicidad. Cada pieza se confecciona bajo demanda para garantizar un acabado impecable. Disfruta de envíos a todo el mundo y lleva el rendimiento al siguiente nivel.
details_en:
· Made to order
· Material: soft-touch polyester
· High, wide elastic waistband
· Two side pockets and one hidden interior back pocket
· Fitted cut with cropped hem above the ankle
details_es:
· Hecho a pedido
· Material: poliéster de tacto suave
· Cintura alta, ancha y elástica
· Dos bolsillos laterales y uno interior oculto en la parte trasera
